title: Beware the Single-Purpose People
alt: An explorer peers downward through a long telescope at one tiny stone while disconnected paths and an expansive misty mountain valley surround them.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide16:9 mature surreal editorial cut-photographic collage for an essay about useful modularity being sabotaged by obsessively tiny responsibilities, losing the coherent whole. A broad real-looking moody mountain valley and rocky footpath stretches across the picture with forest, low cloud and far hills, photographic depth and atmosphere. Near center-left stands a solitary anonymous adult explorer in plain dark wool clothing, side view, small within the expansive landscape, holding a comically long narrow old telescope pointed downward very close to ONE isolated smooth stone at their feet. They inspect the tiny stone intensely while missing that the overall walking path around them is broken into widely separated stepping stones and disconnected directions. The human and telescope are cut from monochrome photographic paper, with subtle visible cut edges, and the rolling surrounding terrain is assembled from two or three overlapping broad photographic fragments in muted forest green, mist gray and ochre. This is narrative photomontage, real large landscape not a miniature tabletop. Wry absurdity comes from excessive focus on one atom when the route as a whole matters. Strong human silhouette and telescope against mist; legible foreground path consequence; sophisticated independent magazine collage, textured photographic grain, generous sky, adult reflective mood. Keep person, telescope, inspected stone and nearby broken path within middle60percent so square can recompose. No thread, stitching, garment panels, boxes, tiny confetti, colored-paper flat object on plain ground, machines, code, words, labels, arrows, logos, watermark, charts, glasses with text, or cartoon children's adventure scene.
notes: Narrative photographic surrealism replaces flat fragmented garment. Person inspects one atom while coherence of the broader route matters.
